notes: Synthetic events with kinds inside and outside 0..0x85, special and plain source/target ids, missing, gone, local, unowned and remote objects, a watched unit, the message filter and network mode. 0x7489c returns the per-case target then source object; 0x7574c returns a per-case dword and clobbers ECX; 0x47764, 0x548a4 and 0x46454 log their register and stack arguments and pop them.
